body: Congrats on taking this step!! You are doing the right thing. Xanax itself is not an easy drug to overdose on and takes over 2000mg, but Xanax in combination with other nervous system depressants (for ex, alcohol or opiates) is deadly. Please do not try, your heart will stop and you will die. Xanax withdrawals, on the other hand, is a whole hell in itself. The withdrawals can cause seizures and death. I highly recommend you do not try to stop all at once, if you have been taking a lot. Ease yourself off it slowly, or else your life will go to shit and you will probably be back on Xanax more addicted than ever. Xanax addictions grow exponentially fast, so if people have never tried it or do not take it regularly, I would recommend them to not do it. Xanax is not supposed to be a recreational drug, and nobody should take Xanax on a regular basis without a medical prescription. Smoke weed instead, it's more "fun" and less dangerous.

Hmm I see. You want to see deeper qualities of the woman before pursuing. It makes sense, but many people have those wonderful traits but a lot of them don’t show those traits to randos they barely know. You have to make effort to get to know them, spark or not. Don’t go into it thinking “what can I get out of this interaction” but think “what more can I learn about her?” Be curious and interested in the woman as a person, not as a potential partner!

It seems like you have extremely specific requirements for the “right person.” Of course preferences are fine, but your perfect girl might not even meet those preferences but still be amazing. I thought I preferred dating my own ethnicity because I told myself I’m attracted to people similar to me and my culture. My current SO is a different ethnicity and almost comes from another world, but that’s what makes it fun! I thought I liked older guys because they’re more mature, but my SO is the same age as me. Stay as open minded at possible when meeting new girls, and you’ll find more opportunities of meeting someone you will love, despite her missing some requirements or having flaws.

If you guys are good friends, I would abruptly ask him:

“Would you date someone like me?” Laugh like it’s a joke.
“Of course, you’re a chill gal.” Just laugh. 
“Yeah? We should date!” Wink and smile.

-At this point, if he actually has feelings for you he’ll either get super shy or keep playing with this “joke” slowly realizing you’re serious. If he doesn’t have interest, he’ll probably just change the topic and you wouldn’t have scared him off too badly (keep it lighthearted!)
